versions.notes: self-check: the loudspeaker hint is shorter.

«Talk» as a quick switch in the camera control - safe against an accidental press: tap once to unlock (6 s; a long press does not unlock), then hold to talk. It replaces the unprotected big button next to the joystick.
own GPS module (USB / serial, or gpsd): location without the phone; theft tracking - when the armed device is carried away, an alarm and then its position (map link) every 5 minutes.
storm warning (Sensors): push message when the air pressure falls fast (BME280), when a wind meter (anemometer on a GPIO) measures strong wind, or (optional) when the forecast expects gusts.

extra sensors (new group «Sensors»): motion detector (PIR), door / lid contact and gas / smoke module on a GPIO, 433 MHz radio sensors (RTL-SDR stick + rtl_433), Zigbee sensors (Zigbee2MQTT over MQTT) and Bluetooth tags (RuuviTag: moved / out of range). Alarm when armed or always (gas); a PIR wakes the power saving mode.
every settings topic has its own symbol (web and window); the camera picture can be turned (90° / 180° / 270°) and mirrored - for a camera mounted sideways or upside down.
thermal camera settings in three parts (alarm / picture / camera & alignment); a button left of the settings search hides the whole settings column (a tab at the right edge brings it back).
the settings search with its three buttons stays at the top while scrolling.

picture for other programs (Home Assistant, Frigate, Blue Iris, VLC, NAS recorders): a secret address for the video (MJPEG) and a still picture, no login needed; optionally RTSP (H.264) if mediamtx is installed.

continuous recording (off by default): all the time with few pictures per second in 10-minute pieces, kept for N hours; the recordings page shows a 24-hour timeline with the alarms marked - tap to watch.
